title: Understanding the Plot
text: The plot shows a U-shaped curve as the value of $$d$$ increases. This suggests that the y-axis could represent a measure that decreases to a minimum and then increases again.

title: Possible Y-Axis Labels
text: Consider what measures in machine learning might decrease and then increase as the complexity of the model changes. Think about training error, validation error, and model complexity.

title: Training Error
text: Could the y-axis represent training error? Training error typically decreases as model complexity increases.

title: Validation Error
text: Could the y-axis represent validation error? Validation error typically decreases to a point and then increases as model complexity increases, due to overfitting.

title: Model Complexity
text: Could the y-axis represent model complexity? Model complexity typically increases as the number of features or parameters increases.
